cases.actual: Technical account administration remained separate from business authority; delegated management and audit checks passed.

cases.journey: Case sensitivity classification, legacy unknown quarantine and reviewed declassification

cases.expected: Application actor is distinct from actual holder; sufficient evidence facts and current chain version required; unknown prior custody retained; ordinary location edits cannot bypass established ledger.
